title: Placebo
scene: London alternative rock / UK indie; Britpop-era outsider
notes: Raw tape-recorded guitar attack and provocative outsider anthems; the band rejects Britpop identification.

title: Without You I’m Nothing

influenced_by: Sonic Youth|PJ Harvey|Nick Cave|The Cure|Joy Division|David Bowie

title: Black Market Music
scene: London alternative rock / UK electro-tinged guitar rock
notes: Compressed darker rock combines electronic loops, programmed strings and a guest rap on one track.

title: Sleeping with Ghosts
scene: London alternative rock; 2000s UK guitar-electronica crossover
notes: Vintage synthesizers and restless guitars frame uneasy explorations of love and fallible memory.

title: Meds
scene: London alternative rock; post-punk-influenced 2000s guitar rock

title: Battle for the Sun
